claims.quote: Etymology: Parauchenoglanis: para-, near, referring to similarity and/or close relationship with Auchenoglanis. ngamensis: -ensis, suffix denoting place: Lake Ngami district, Botswana, type locality.

regions.name: Okavango
regions.quote: Parauchenoglanis ngamensis is currently distributed across the Okavango and the upper Zambezi, Kwanza, and Kasai (sub)basins of southern Africa.
